nom: Pacifica Glow Baby Brightening Face Wash

avis.titre: not good for combo skin (oily and normal)
avis.texte: After washing my face with this two times, I began to have a really bad breakout around my T-zone and chin. This is probably a good product just not for those with oily skin since it exfoliates. I was pretty disappointed, I've been wanting to buy products that are cruelty free and have cleaner ingredients.
I've used this product for over 3 months and now its near the end of the tube. Removes full face of makeup unless waterproof, then double cleanse. Has a pleasant orange scent, slightly sweet.
Love everything about this product. My favorite thing is how it leaves my face feeling so clean and smooth and refreshed. Love it use it everyday!!

I thought this was going to be a great, affordable cleanser for my skin. I struggle with dark spots and really needed something to help brighten those and thought this was it. But the two times I've used this, I've gotten chemical burns around my nose. I really don't understand why because I've used other products in the past with the same ingredients. I guess I'll just have to go back to my more expensive cleanser

I think having both vitamin C and AHA was too much for my skin to handle. I didn't have a reaction at first, no redness, bumps, burns. I used this as my daily morning cleanser for about two weeks. Eventually my skin would sting when applying moisturizer and sunblock after cleansing with this product. I stopped using the cleanser and the feeling went away within a week. I'm assuming this disrupted my skin barrier and it took some time to heal
This is a lovely, cruelty-free and vegan face wash. I always feel confident using Pacifica products on my skin, and this is a great one. This size is also perfect for travel!
Smells amazing. Feels even better. Doesn't strip the moisture in my face and gives me a great base to start the day!
Got this for a Christmas gift, after 1 wash my face was burning . I will not use again.
I like! like! Very good on my sensitive skin! Good for my sensitive skin. Good on my under eye dark circles! Very good product! I am pleased 😀
This smelled sooooo good and genuinely felt brightening and cleansing 🤩

I've re-purchased this so many times! I love the consistency and how well it foams up! This cleanser help face so much and really brightens it! I would recommend this to anyone who has dry/dull skin. I'm telling you this is need, pls go buy it right now!!!!
I have combo skin and this face wash DRIED my skin out soooo bad. Like all over my skin

Used it 2 times and my face started itching then to burning and now super red and have tiny bumps and blisters on my face. It hurts a lot and is super super itchy. I don't have sensitive skin. Don't buy!!!!

avis.titre: Messy packaging and bright color stains
avis.texte: I bought this thinking it could be a dupe for OleHenriksen vitamin C cleanser, but it couldn't be farther away from the truth. The bottle's mechanism makes it so a lot of excess product gets dispensed and messy. The bright orange color stained my towels and my bathroom sink. And it doesn't do much for the skin either.

avis.titre: Love this will be buying this again soon..
avis.texte: Okay this face wash is greaattt I absolutely love this kinda sad bc i am running out but i get to buy a new one 🎉🥳i dont know if it really exfoliates but definitely makes me have a glow and cleared up my acne so I definitely recommend RUN AND GO GET IT
I have normal skin that can be blemish prone. This cleanser makes my skin less dull, gently exfoliated, and a little bit goes a long way.

I usually have pretty clear skin but lately I have been breaking out like crazy!! Could be post partum hormones but who knows. This face wash cleared my skin and made it look better than before! Even my sister who is my biggest critic noticed a brighter appearance in my skin! I love it so much and definitely will be repurchasing.
I got a mini in my Ipsy bag and bought the full size. This fave wash just lives my skin. I also bought the serum. This product is my go to now for my skincare routine. Been using it a month now.

avis.titre: Good acids but kinda funky smell
avis.texte: I love the ingredients, however, there's a tiny scent that is a bit like ripe papaya yet there are no papaya enzymes. I'm very sensitive to smell. It doesn't smell like vanilla. It says there are essential oils in it, there are preservatives so I don't think those oils are going bad, I guess I just don't like the smell, sorry.

Oh no this made me breakout. I never breakout and when I do its because my skin cannot tolerate the product. I had a sample if this so decided to try it when I ran out of my usual cleanser. What a regret. For about a week my face looked horrible. Immediately after I stopped using it it cleared up and looks so smooth and beautiful again.

I've been using this face wash for a few months now and love it. The scent alone (orange pound cake?) is earning my loyalty. The bonus is that is makes my face feel clean without feeling dry. Also love that it's a travel friendly container.
I HAVE A DARK SPOT ON MY RIGTH CHEECK AND EVER SINCE I'VE USED THIS FACE WASH ITS SLOWLY GONE AWAY. THIS FACE WASH HAS MY SKIN LOOKING AMAZING AFTER A FEW WASHES. THIS PRODUCT IS A 10 OUT OF 10
I use this face wash in the morning and it is great for a light exfoliating and brightening wash. Leaves my skin feeling soft and clean and ready for make up.
I'm in love with this face wash. It does wonders for my skin.
This is my fave Pacifica face wash! It feels and smells bright and it cleans everything off very well.
I have struggled wirh dark spots and my aesthetician reccomended this after reducing it with her more expensive products. It has maintained my skin complexion and for a cheaper price.

avis.titre: I probably won't buy this again
avis.texte: I will start off that for the price of this face wash it is a okay deal. This does smell good so another star for that. And it does foam up really well. But overall it didn't really do anything special for my skin. I didn't notice any of the claims it said it would improve my skin. I won't be buying this again unless it's on clearance.
When the rose kombucha face wash was discontinued, I found this one to be a great replacement.

used this product only once and it's the worse product i've ever used. after one use my skin was inflamed and burning. it's been a week now and my skin still burns. everything i put on my face burns my skin, even the moisturizer i've been using for three years.

genuinely smells so good!!! i can definitely see how it helped "even out" my skin. the only weird thing is it has this bright yellow color but other than that it's fine. You dont need to use a lot for it to lather up which is cool

genuinely smells so good!!! i can definitely see how it helped "even out" my skin. the only weird thing is it has this bright yellow color but other than that it's fine. You dont need to use a lot for it to lather up which is cool
the color of this makes me very uncomfortable. I feel like I'm putting yellow paint on my skin and there's no way that's good

I purchased this product recently and woke up the next day with the worst allergic reaction i've ever experienced in my life. My left eye completely closed up and stayed that was for hours only going down with medication. My face also puffed up and was the most red i've seen it since i was a baby straight out of the womb, not to mention the intense and agonizing hives. It was the only product out of the ordinary of my regular skincare rotation, and just to be sure i patch tested on my wrist and got hives there as well. I've never had very many issues with AHA or BHA related products, but my skin is still dry patchy and scratchy even 3 days after.
This face wash is very hydrating. My skin always feels so smooth after. It has been my go-to for years!
This is a great scent for a face wash. I always feel refreshed after using it.
Love, love , love ❤️ first, the smell……it's a dreamy creamsicle for your face. It's a nice, light facewash with huge results. It made my skin soft, supple and glowing
This felt good when I first used it. After about 10 minutes my face started to burn. I washed my face again and splashed cold water on it to calm it down.

avis.titre: Smells bad, haven't noticed any benefits
avis.texte: I was excited to try this face wash, but unfortunately, I won't be buying again. I usually love Pacifica's products, but this face wash has a gross smell to it. It's also bright yellow, which is a bit odd to me. I haven't really noticed any difference when I use this compared to a normal face wash, so I won't be buying again.

My husband used this one day after finding it in the shower and said his skin felt so soft afterwards. He never says good things about beauty products. For that reason alone, this product gets five stars.

avis.titre: Great for brightening and friendly for acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I have been using this face wash for a couple years now and I absolutely can't recommend it enough. I am acne-prone and it does not irritate or clog my skin. It's definitely refreshing and brightening.

The bright yellow is disturbing. It just looks weird when you apply it to your face. It definitely tinged my white facecloth. I missed some spots on my sink and the nrxt day i needed to take a magic eraser to them. Nice feeling product but i cant get past the color or the scent.

At first I could not figure out where the mystery stains were coming from on my new towels after getting new nee towels I figured out that it was this product that was staining them! is this even safe?!

pros: gentle. I left it on for 10 seconds before washing off, and my pores feel pretty darn clear. mellow exfoliants, Giles a light glow. Does not feel drying right after use. THE SCENT: funky but tolerable! it gives orange creamsicle (there are citrus notes and vanilla together). some people hate it, some love it. I accept it lol (I hated the scent though when it came to the glow baby tinted moisturizer - it stunk, and pilled no matter what I did to stop the pilling). cons: neon yellow!! it looks weird when you take a peek at how your face looks with the bright yellow goop framing the suds on your face haha! it also can get on your shirt, so maybe use it before you put on your going-out clothes. also some may transfer onto your towel when done. it all washes out though. absolutely stellar product for the price point. only cons is the neon yellow tint that may transfer to clothing (washable tho). Scent is love or hate, but it does not linger (unlike the tinted moisturizer)

I absolutely love the Glow Baby products. I have tried most of them and the formulations are incredible and smell so fresh and citrusy! I'm hooked on the face wash and love the it's deep cleaning effect when I shower before bed. Highly recommend!
I'm 77!!! EXCELLENT PRODUCT I LOOK N FEEL Like I'm 50 The glow the wrinkles are so much softer looking Thank you THANK YOU KEEP MAKING MORE OF THIS CLEAN OCEAN BRAND

This is probably the best face wash I've ever used! I swear my face looked brighter after one use! I love the vanilla orange scent and even the unexpected yellow color. The whole experience was a treat!
This is so good I love how it even out the tone and it makes my skin brighter!
I have tried most face cleansers Ulta has to offer, and this is pretty generic. It does its job, but isn't anything special. Good for a basic skin routine. Enjoy!
I love the smell and texture of this face wash. It's a nice pick me up in the mornings.
My favorite morning face wash. I feel so fresh and glowy after. And it smells so good.
I love Pacifica products and I can tell my skin is improving ❤️ And is brighter and more youthful !

Alluring packaging but that is IT. I would not recommend this product at all. More so especially for my sensitive skin people. It completely strips the skin feeling so dry & tight & also broke my skin out.

Ive tried like a bajillion of products, brands, luxurious versus drug store, you name it. Ive tried almost everything but nothing quite works like this one right here, its why i keep coming back. Nothing can quite compare. Immediately after one wash you can see the difference. A little goes a long way, so don't drench yourself on becoming a yellow blob mess.
Probably the best product in the Glow Baby line. Within a couple of uses my skin looked a lot better.

I love this cleanser, it has chemical expholiants but doesn't dry out your skin. It makes my skin tone bright and even and moisturized. Smells like orange creamsicle, great for 2nd cleansing after an oil cleanse or for morning cleanse to make your skin bright for your day. Takes makeup off pretty well too. Try it today and i hope you will love the results

I have normal skin. I do not have oily, dry, discoloration, nor sensitive skin. I still wanted to get in the habit of a face routine though. This face wash I believe made me break out bcz it feels dry after it's all washed off. I might try it again in a few months to be certain before I throw it in the trash.

WOW! I am going to turn 50 this year. I switched to Pacifica about a year ago, because I wanted to use vegan and cruelty free products exclusively and this is the first I one I tried. I had previously been using an extremely expensive skincare line that gave me subpar results. Since switching to the Glow Baby line my skin is more beautiful than ever. I have received more compliments on my skin in the last year than I have my entire life! To say I am happy would be an understatement! I am ecstatic and my skin is truly glowing!
It's a great face wash, but the bottle sizing is completely too small. Think it's like a 5 oz tube. Please produce item at least in a 12 oz container!
So far I'm very happy with this lotion. I tend to get rashes on my neck and this has not irritated my skin.
I bought this because I heard how great it was and the people were right it makes your skin so smooth and brighten my under eyes.
Very gentle. Leaves my skin feeling clean but it doesn't dry it out.

Very good- I would definitely buy it again, however, is not as gentle as I would like it to be on my eyes. Basically what I'm trying to say is- you can't accidentally open your eyes, even a little bit or else it will be very irritating.

avis.titre: Excellent Cleanser for an Excellent Price
avis.texte: I bought this to reestablish a skincare routine and I'm in love with this product. I use it every other day and the smell is amazing and my skin is looking glowy from using this! It doesn't irritate my skin and I have dry/sensitive skin.
This face wash works so great, love how foamy it gets, and it cleans the oil off so well. I use it morning and night, perfect face wash.

I don't break out often. When I do it's around the time I get my period and it's pretty bad. When I use this all the acne/blemishes disappear within a day. This rescues me for photoshoots and feeling confident in my own skin. I also love the way it smells and how lightweight it feels. Would love to see it in an aluminum tube instead of plastic.
I've been using this since it came out and I love how youthful and dewy my skin looks!!!

A reasonable quality for the price. Maybe it's mostly because I'm a fan of citrus. I like the mildly acidulated fragrance when dispensing and the slight tingle on my face when I rub it in, all screaming "Ascorbic acid!" that makes me feel so healthy.
Saw a big difference in my skin after using for one week. Much brighter and my tone has evened out a bit
This non irritating face wash product is actually refreshing to use on a once daily regiment. Enjoy the fragrance of citrus!
A little does go a long way but its honestly too tough for everyday and very drying.

It was free. It smells wonderful. The texture of my skin was baby smooth. Face plumped up. It is very milld for AHA. Normal i cant use that chemical on my skin. This one i can for little over a week before i have to give my skin a break. I am very impressed with the product.
I rexommend this product. It smella freat and ia good ar removing make up. My face feels amooth afterwards .
I doubt I'm going to finish this. My face still feels dirty and it stinks.
I love this wash. A little goes a long way and it smells so good. I have only been using this for a week and I have noticed a change in my skin. I can't wait to see how I look after a month.
Not my favorite face wash tbh. It smells amazing but it left my face feeling dry.
I bought this line for my 13 YO daughter. She loves it. It's a clean product and the price point is perfect.
Since I've been using this face wash I have received so many compliments on my skin ! Skin looks brighter and glowy
I'm on my 3rd bottle of this facial wash and will continue to buy !! Definitely worth the buy !!
I've been using this for two months now and it's really making a difference for my acne scars. This collection also smells amazing!
I've been a fan of this facial cleanser for a while now. It definitely brightens your complex and gives you a natural glow. And the smell is AMAZING!

My skin loves this! My skin is middle-aged and sensitive and pale and hates everything, so this cleanser is very special. It evened my skin tone after two uses. I look amazing lol! I've only just bought it so I can't review long-term use, but it's a good sign that my finicky skin is already better because of it. This gets 5 stars when Pacifica becomes Leaping Bunny certified.

avis.titre: Makes me smell like ice cream!
avis.texte: Works on my sensitive skin with no irritation and cleanses well. I use it daily along with the Glow Baby Vitaglow face lotion. I also love that it smells just like an Orange Creamsicle!
Smells good, cleanses well, and kind of reminds me of vegan Neutrogena face wash. Lathers up nicely and a little goes a long way.
Great cleanser for my sensitive skin. My face is brighter and I have far fewer blemishes.
Love this face wash. I have been using it for a while now. Suds up well and makes your face feel clean and fresh.

Over time I used this in combination with Beekman and I feel as if it dried my face out even more. I did notice my skin becoming brighter. I would have to try this with maybe their moisturizer instead of mixing and matching products.
This is a great product but I do think it's a little on the thicker side of similar Pacifica products.
i am impressed with all of pacifica beauty products. this product is outstanding!!! i need to stock up on this.
I love the fragrance of this face wash. And my skin feels GREAT from use.

avis.titre: Vit C let my skin glow and look younger and fresh
avis.texte: I use the Vit C products changing with collagen products and this works great on my skin. Vit C let my skin glow and it seems so clean and fresh.

I love the way this face wash smells. It is yellow, but it doesnt stain. The only issue i had was daily use. I realized my face felt super dry and started flaking. I only use this once a week and it works well. I guess my skin is just super sensitive.
I love this facial wash !!!! It cleanses my skin gently, but thoroughly. It leaves no residue. My skin feels hydrated & refreshed afterwards!
Not for me, it burnt my face when I used it. I would be careful if u have acne or sensitive skin as it might hurt your face as well.
Makes my skin look and feel refreshed and younger. Smells wonderful. Will continue to buy this.
I enjoy this cleanser a truly does brighten my skin. It is a weird yellow color but I think most things with vitamin C you have a tint to them! It cleans really well!
i just brought this & im loving it along with the serum it smells great & you don't need a-lot of it to get the job done

Seems fine- light scent but pleasant. It says exfoliate but I can't detect anything in this that would actually do that as it is super smooth. The color is bright and that was a bit surprising. But I'm quite pleased with it. My face doesn't feel stretched and taut after washing with it.

Not for me! I dont really have skin major issues or sensitive skin. Occasionally a little dry skin but that comes with the change of weather. However this after one use in the shower instantly caused major irritation and dryness. Skin was tight and very itchy even after applying moisturizer, serums and face oils.

I was accused of having Botox and even regular facials a few months after I started using this, and I will be 55!!! Amazing product...thank you for giving me such beautiful skin (and making others think I go to professionals to get this look)!!
